args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1, the service failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. The release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is ~0.2%. Next step: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with about an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** **INC-0001** (SEV2) describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. There were no open incidents before, so it isn't a duplicate.

Someone still needs to find out what broke in v2.3.1 before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
